The '''Valahari system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[D'Astan sector/Legends|D'Astan sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Valahari/Legends|Valahari]].<ref name="TCW10" />
